temperatures.name: Setpoints
temperatures.description: Six setpoints: Nobody, Night and Day while heating, then the same three while cooling.

days.name: Days
days.description: Eight days, Monday first and 'day 8' last. Each is {transitions: [[time, level], ...], as_monday: bool}, where time counts 5 minute steps from midnight (0-287) and level is 0 Nobody, 1 Night or 2 Day.
